about_the_game:
NOTE: It is recommended to play Watamari Part1 - A Match Made in Heaven prior to playing this game!

Story

Yata Hime has infiltrated the academy on a mission to root out its secrets.

Hoshino Hikari is another spy sent to the school, and in order to cover for her careless comments, Hime starts a fake relationship with her. But due to a charm spell that Hikari cast unintentionally, Hime has fallen in love with her.

As she tries to accomplish her mission as a spy and looks for a way to break the spell, the feelings between Hikari and Hime begin to change...

The academy's problem child, Yakumo Nene, secretly uses her "imaginary angels" in order to make some of the women there fall in love with each other. And today, she orders one of her angels (you) to bring Hikari and Hime closer together.

Concept

A next-generation yuri visual novel game where the player is also a participant!

The player isn't the main character, but an angel that works for one of the game's other characters, who guides the main characters to the choices that they will make.

  • Depending on the character involved, they might not listen to you even if you provide a choice

  • The guidance you provide may change the story and potential routes

  • But what does it mean if the player is able to interfere with the world of Watamari...?

Features

  • Live2D animated character sprites that brings characters to life including each of their unique and cute mannerisms

  • Yuri-focused UI that displays two character's feelings for each other as if reading a yuri manga

  • Characters in this story are unleashed by the player! Even though each of the girls have their own lives, it isn't right that the player can only control the main heroine. A "certain voice" will help you guide these girls forward. The choice is in their hands.

  • English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese language support

  • Full Japanese audio support

short_description: This is a yuri game where you as an angel of love must help guide the heroines. Do your best, little angel (you) and take care of your mistress's wellbeing!

English, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
